verdict.rationale: Docs describe adding provider credentials via Virtual Keys/Model Catalog ('Add a provider, then use @provider-slug/model-name'), with credentials stored securely and never exposed in code, and the gateway then routing traffic using those keys across 250+/1600+ models and providers (AWS, Azure, Vertex, on-prem). This directly supports bringing your own provider API keys for gateway-routed traffic. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the BYO-key flow and more detail on multi-provider key rotation/security auditing beyond docs claims.
